description: DATA OUTPUT (curated on the getlevel-3 precedent): computes the frequency list that 'filter bank' would use and writes it to a TEXT FILE instead of filtering - one frequency per line, printf '%.6f' format (probed: 200.000000 / 400.000000 / ...). Pinned to submode 1 (HARMONIC SERIES over lof, capped at hif); submodes 2-6 (alternate harmonics, subharmonic series below hif - probed: 2000, 1000, 666.666667, 500 -, harmonic+linear-offset, equal-Hz-count and equal-semitone-interval - the tranche-9 geometric/semitone findings for bank 5/6 carry) take the same argv, modes 4-6 with one extra param. The input sound is ONLY a properties donor - no audio is read for content and stereo is accepted; the banner's 'srate determines frq range' is NOT enforced (a 22.05 kHz file accepted hif 8000 > srate/3; real enforced range is the constant 0.1-22050, verbatim refusal probed). hif < lof is SILENTLY SWAPPED (byte-identical list - family behavior). Deterministic (two runs byte-identical text). The output does NOT feed userbank/varibank directly: those need 'pitch amp' PAIRS and refuse a bare frequency column ('Not enough values on line 1') - append an amplitude to each line first (the banner says exactly this).
musical_use: The bank-designer's scratchpad: generate the harmonic series (or its siblings) as editable text, then sculpt - delete members, detune a few, append per-filter amplitudes - and feed the result to filter userbank (or use the frequencies in varibank lines). This turns the closed harmonic bank into an open one: keep only odd harmonics for hollow clarinet resonance, thin the top for darkness, nudge members off-grid for bell inharmonicity. Also handy as pure reference data: read the file to know exactly which frequencies filter bank mode 1 would ring for given lof/hif before committing to a heavy render. Chain: bankfrqs -> edit/add amps (write_data_file) -> userbank.

lof.description: Fundamental of the series / low frequency limit. CDP-enforced 0.1 to 22050 ('Parameter[1] Value (-5.000000) out of range (0.100000 to 22050.000000)') - the banner's '0 to srate/3' is not what the binary checks. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 3 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' - stage numbering).

hif.description: Upper frequency limit - harmonics above this are omitted (a ceiling, not a member; last listed value sits below it). Same real range as lof; hif < lof silently swapped (verified byte-identical list); values above srate/3 accepted silently even on low-rate files.

examples.description: Harmonic series over 110 Hz up to 2 kHz, as editable text.
examples.expected_use: Writes 110.000000, 220.000000, ... one per line. Edit, append amplitudes, then feed to filter userbank.

known_issues: DATA OUTPUT: the result is a text file (one '%.6f' frequency per line), not audio - duration model static per data-output convention; verify_output checks existence/size only.

NOT directly consumable by userbank/varibank: they demand 'pitch amp' pairs and refuse the bare column ('ERROR: Not enough values on line 1: file ...' - verified). Append an amplitude to every line first.

The input soundfile is a properties donor only; despite the banner ('sampling rate of input soundfile determines frq range'), the enforced range is the constant 0.1-22050 (a 22.05 kHz input accepted hif 8000 > srate/3, exit 0). Stereo inputs accepted.
hif < lof silently swapped (byte-identical output) - the bank-family inverted-range behavior.

Submodes 2-6 share the argv (4-6 add one param: offset Hz / filter count / semitone interval) and inherit the tranche-9 bank findings: mode 5 spacing is GEOMETRIC (equal pitch intervals) despite 'equally spaced' wording, mode 6 steps 2^(interval/12) from lof and never reaches hif. Separate triples, not curated.
Deterministic (byte-identical reruns). An existing output file of the same name is refused (CDP no-overwrite), matching the engine's fresh-name policy.
